}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== ===Feature=== *CPU: [[MediaTek]] MT7988A (Filogic 880) :Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A73) @1.8GHz *RAM: 1GB (DDR4) *Flash: 128MB (SPI NAND), 8GB (eMMC) *Ports: 1x 10GbE (SFP), 4x 1GbE ports *USB: 1x USB 3.2 port *2x M.2 (A/E Key) slots with PCIe 3.0 :2-lane interface for Wi-Fi 7 NIC *1x M.2 (B Key) slot with USB 3.2 :interface for 4G/5G WWAN Module *Frame Engine, QoS DMS (QDMA) *Packet Aggregated DMA (A-DMA) *Packet Switch Engine (PSE)
===Models=== *[[AsiaRF AP7988-001]] • Wi-Fi 7 BE19000 Router Board *[[AsiaRF AW7256-P01]] • Wi-Fi 7 BE19000 M.2 (Key A/E)/Mini PCIe NIC Module {{See also|MediaTek reference design}}
